body:
## Resource suggestion

- **Name:** awesome-jev
- **URL:** https://github.com/Promethe-us/awesome-jev
- **GitHub:** Promethe-us/awesome-jev
- **Category:** Other Awesome Lists

The project is actively maintained and published at https://promethe-us.github.io/awesome-jev/.
